رُطَبٌ مَصَلِّبٌ , (S, K,) and تَمْرَةٌ مُصَلِّبَةٌ, (M,) [Ripe dates, and a date,] becoming, or having become, dry. (S, M, K.) When date-honey (دِبْس) has been poured on such dates, that they may become soft, they are termed مُصَقَّرٌ. (S.) ＝
-A2- مَطَرٌ مُصَلِّبٌ Vehement, injurious rain. (L, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
